title: TUI detail pane docs match what i does
lead: Two s278 gate nits: the `deps_lines` docstring and docs/tui.md describe the dependencies pane and the `i` key on a prose block slightly wrong.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** scrolling the history pane; caching the log between redraws (about 20 ms per frame re-read on this repo).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The s278 gate (2026-10-17) passed with two later notes. `deps_lines` in `src/slicer/tui.py:437` says it shows "what `slicer deps ID` prints, without the JSON", but `slicer deps` text output has no `blocked by` line, while the pane has one plus a `held by slivers` line. `docs/tui.md:45` says that on a roadmap prose block `i` "does nothing", but `View.handle` notifies "that key applies to a slice, not to a prose block".

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: reword the `deps_lines` docstring to say it shows the data behind `slicer deps ID`, including `blocked by` from its JSON and any open slivers.
- `docs/tui.md`: say that on a prose block `i` shows a message and keeps the details.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None: a docstring and a docs sentence. The existing `test_tui` and docs-coverage tests stay green.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reword the docstring.
2. Reword the docs/tui.md sentence.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full discover (the docstring is under `src/`). `slicer check` and `git diff --check` pass.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
